name: nouride-wa-bridge
description: WhatsApp bridge for Nouride — its own module, compiled into the daemon and speaking newline-delimited JSON to it.
comment: A workspace member on @nouride/runtime, like every package here; it was its own repository
`libsignal` is pointed at a local shim that forwards to `whatsapp-rust-bridge` (MIT). The real
package is GPL-3.0 and is the only reason a binary carrying this bridge would be a combined
work — Baileys itself is MIT. The override lives in the ROOT package.json, because overrides
only apply there in a workspace; apps/engine/tests/contracts/wa-bridge-licence.test.ts fails
if the real one ever lands in bun.lock.
